# Agentic Income — expanded discovery document

> Earn with agents. Keep the judgment. The operating system for people who build income with AI agent teams: dated playbooks, verified partner economics, working code, and a live MCP server your agents can query directly.

This file is the expanded companion to https://www.agenticincome.ai/llms.txt. The short file is an index; this file carries full section detail, tool boundaries, and disclosure rules so assistants and agents can cite accurate facts without overclaiming.

Operator and author: Frank Riemer (https://www.frankx.ai).
Site: https://www.agenticincome.ai

## 1. Live MCP server and agent discovery

- Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://www.agenticincome.ai/api/mcp (accepts POST; GET returns 405 by design)
- Discovery manifest: https://www.agenticincome.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- Documentation: https://www.agenticincome.ai/mcp
- Connect in Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http agentic-income https://www.agenticincome.ai/api/mcp`

### Recommended agent workflow

1. Query live inventory via MCP `tools/list` or `/.well-known/mcp.json`.
2. Select the `source_to_offer` prompt to review an offer hypothesis with `draft_income_graph`.
3. Call `draft_offer_experiment` to calculate contribution margin and export a sourced brief.
4. Open the resulting JSON at https://www.agenticincome.ai/workbench/offer-brief to edit locally or export as Markdown.
5. **Human gate**: A human supplies all price and variable cost assumptions and approves every external publication, enrollment, spend, or customer communication.

## 2. The three operator income models

Agentic Income organizes operator workflows into three explicit models, each documented with labor profiles, realistic ramp ranges, and known failure modes:

- **Services** — Client delivery, technical architecture, and advisory work accelerated by inspectable agent workflows.
- **Products** — Reusable digital kits, templates, code packs, and playbooks shipped with explicit verification receipts.
- **Systems** — Repeatable content, distribution, and partner-referral loops operated with human review gates.

We never guarantee or promise income. Every economic claim carries a primary source or verification date.

## 3. Partner registry and affiliate disclosure

- Some outbound recommendations use referral links routed via `go.agenticincome.ai`, where Agentic Income may earn a commission at no additional cost to the buyer.
- Partner entries record commission rates, cookie windows, and verification dates.
- Editorial rule: the honest recommendation wins even when no payout route exists.
- Full policy: https://www.agenticincome.ai/disclosure

## 4. Product status and boundaries

- **Available now (free)**: The free Starter Kit and the public MCP tools listed in `/.well-known/mcp.json`.
- **Gated paid catalog**: Paid items (Blueprint $67, Private Intel $19/mo, and pack editions) display their real gated status until live checkout is opened. Nothing is purchasable unless the live catalog explicitly marks it for sale.
- Free MCP tools remain free; any future paid capability will be announced transparently on the catalog and never enabled silently.
